series: Social Security automatic-determination COLA history by determination year
year_semantics: calendar year of SSA's automatic COLA determination

historical_timing.1975-1982: effective in June and first reflected in July payments of the named year
historical_timing.1983-2022: effective in December of the determination year and first reflected in January payments of the following year

provenance.source: Social Security Administration, Office of the Chief Actuary, Cost-of-Living Adjustments
provenance.vintage: Official automatic-determination history through determination year 2022; later live-page rows are intentionally outside this artifact's vintage.
provenance.transcription_method: Values manually transcribed into scripts/extract_ssa_cola_history.py; the build performs no network access.
provenance.transcription_verification: The complete determination-year transcription was checked row by row against the official SSA series during the PR #286 adversarial implementation review.
provenance.content_hash_basis: sha256 of the UTF-8 canonical JSON encoding of the complete data object (sorted keys, compact separators, trailing newline)

build.reproducible: rendered deterministically from the pinned in-script transcription; no network or wall-clock timestamp is used
